root_cause: The control-plane convergence introduced bounded shallow Git history in Skill Projection and Required, but two downstream assumptions remained stale: the canonicalization regression still required fetch-depth 0, and the Integration Bundle CLI still used triple-dot BASE...HEAD, which requires merge-base ancestry not present in a targeted shallow checkout.
prevention: All control-plane components now share the same shallow-safe invariant: Skill Projection requires fetch-depth 2, and Integration Bundle computes exact candidate scope with two-tree git diff BASE HEAD after a bounded targeted fetch for explicit commit objects. Full-history and merge-base-dependent assumptions are rejected by regression.

evidence.integration_error: fatal: no merge base for BASE...HEAD
